mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below 100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index signals a tightening monetary cycle with low inflation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during monetary tightening cycles with low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a very strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and a decline in the federal funds rate signals a robust demand environment with easy monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: early-cycle expansion with easy monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions with easy monetary policy (t-test p > 0.05).
